# Net Forge platformer template (SKYLEDGE)

> A side-view race to the flag for up to 8 players over cliffside courses,
> with seat bots filling empty places. A round is one course; the next round
> runs the next course. You change the game by editing src/game.ts only. The
> template already has the run and jump motor (coyote time, jump buffering,
> variable jump height, air dash, springs, one-way ledges, moving platforms),
> checkpoints and falls, per-player coins, the race clock and places, bots
> that run planned routes, netcode with client prediction, rendering in every
> art style, keyboard, gamepad and touch controls, earn and the store. Do not
> write renderers, netcode, physics or bot AI.

## Files

- src/game.ts: THE GAME. Declarations against @netforge/engine:
  game(), upgrade(), system(), earn.rule(), earn.stake(), store.sku().
- src/names.json: the title and every label players read (upgrades, earn
  rules, store items).
- Everything else is template machinery.

## Rules the build enforces

- game({ template: "platformer", style: "lowpoly", levels: [...] }) with 1 to 8 levels.
- No weapon(), director(), keeper() or enemy prefabs: the challenge is the course.
- Every course must be finishable: the gate runs a route planner from the start
  to the flag on every level, and a level with no route fails the build.
- Asset ids look like "style.lowpoly.rogue", never URLs or paths, and must be in the asset library.
- game({ style }) is the art style the creator picked: lowpoly, toon, ps1, pixel, voxel or handdrawn. Keep it.
- Ids are lower_snake_case. Every game declares at least one earn.rule and one earn.stake (the buy-in run).
- Upgrades raise one of: speed (run speed), amount (extra air jumps),
  magnet (coin reach, m), maxHealth (shield hits per life), haste (dash cooldown).
- 4 players plus seat bots must all reach the flag, and an earn rule must
  fire, in a 4-minute playtest.

## Units

Seconds, metres, metres per second. Side view: x runs right from the start
to the flag, y runs up. Tick rate 60 Hz. A climber's body is 0.68 m wide and
1.4 m tall; feet are at its y.

## The loop

Everyone starts at the level's start. A 3 s countdown, then the race: run
(A/D, arrows, stick), jump (Space/W/Up, A on a pad; hold for a full jump, tap
for a hop), dash (Shift, X on a pad; once in the air, refilled on landing),
Down + Jump drops through a ledge. Thorns and the drop send you back to the
last checkpoint you touched. Touch the flag to finish; your place is the
order of finishing. The round closes a few seconds after every person has
finished, or at round.seconds. The results show, then the next course.

Numbers that make the default feel: run 7.5 m/s, a full jump 3.3 m high in
0.36 s, a tap jump about 1.4 m, coyote 0.1 s, jump buffer 0.13 s, fall
gravity x1.75, dash 16 m/s for 0.16 s. A full running jump clears a gap of
about 6 m; with the dash about 8.5 m.

## Building a course

Coordinates are metres. Helpers you can write in game.ts:
const ground = (x0, x1, y = 0) => [x0, y - 4, x1 - x0, 4];   // ground from x0 to x1, top at y
levels: [{
  name: "Mossy Steps",
  start: [0, 0],                 // feet of every climber at the start
  flag: [128, 4.5],              // the flag's foot: stand it on a block top
  blocks: [ground(-8, 24), [14, 0, 3, 1.2], ...],   // [x, y, width, height] from the bottom-left corner
  ledges: [[40, 2.6, 4]],        // [x, top y, width]: one-way, jump up through, Down + Jump drops
  hazards: [[35, 0, 2, 0.5]],    // [x, y, width, height]: thorns
  springs: [[59, 0, 21]],        // [x, y, launch speed m/s]: 21 is about 4.5 m up
  movers: [{ at: [81, 0, 3], to: [5, 0], seconds: 4 }],   // a 3 m platform at x 81, swinging 5 m right and back every 4 s
  coins: [[4, 1], [5.2, 1]],     // centres; each climber collects their own (at most 62)
  checkpoints: [[31, 0], [92, 0]], // feet, in course order
}]
Rules of thumb: steps up of 1 to 2.5 m, gaps of 2 to 5 m (6 with a running
jump, 8 with the dash), a checkpoint every 30 to 50 m, coins along the line a
good run takes and a few on a harder high road. A course of 120 to 180 m runs
in 16 to 25 s for a good climber. killY (optional) is the fall line; default
8 m under the lowest block.

## Common changes

### A new course
Add a level object to levels. Courses rotate one per round in order.

### Tune the feel
motor: { runSpeed: 8, jumpHeight: 3.6, airJumps: 1 } (runSpeed 3-14, jumpHeight 1-8,
timeToApex 0.2-0.7, fallGravity 1-3, jumpCut 0.2-1, coyoteSeconds and
bufferSeconds 0-0.25, airJumps 0-2, dashSpeed 6-30). Change a few at a
time; the planner re-checks every course with the new numbers.

### Round length and bots
round: { seconds: 180 } (60 to 600). players.bots: 3 fills a room up to 3
players with seat bots (0 turns them off). Bots run planned routes and start
a little after the signal (looser bots later), never earn, and a win over a
field of bots pays nothing extra.

### Add an earn rule
earn.rule("speedy", { when: "player.finished", n: 1, pay: 6, oncePer: "run" });
Events: player.finished (you reached the flag), race.won (first to the flag,
paid only with another person in the round), race.podium (top three, same),
coin.collected (credits the collector), checkpoint.reached, player.fell,
spring.bounced, round.finished (everyone present), run.started (unpaid: a
player's earning run started over), and anything you emit(). A run is a
round; each rule pays once per round per player, in coins; the room server
is the referee; bots never earn.

### Track something with a system
system("clean_climb", ({ on, emit }) => {
  const falls = new Map<number, number>();
  on("player.fell", (ids) => { for (const id of ids) falls.set(id, (falls.get(id) ?? 0) + 1); });
  on("player.finished", (ids) => { const clean = ids.filter((id) => !falls.get(id)); if (clean.length) emit("climb.clean", clean); });
  on("run.started", (ids) => { for (const id of ids) falls.delete(id); });
});
Systems also have every(seconds, fn), after, onTick, players(), random(),
announce(text), upcoming(label, seconds) and end() (closes the round now).
spawn and enemies are not part of this template.

### The buy-in run (required)
earn.stake({ min: 10, max: 100, multiple: 2 });
Every game declares one, on one top-level line. A player stakes coins at the
start of a run; a staked run pays its normal earn plus a share of
stake x multiple (the share is the part of the run's most earn the player
makes). What it does not win back stays in the reward pool. multiple is 1
to 2. "stake" is reserved: never a SKU id.

### Losable gear (optional)
store.sku("shield_charm", { coins: 120, grants: { gear: "shield", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
Owned in the player's profile, coins only. It brings one level of its upgrade
into every staked run and is lost when that run makes less than loseBelow of
its most earn.

### Coins: earn and the store
Every game has coins: 1 coin = 1 of the game's own token, shown under the
token's own name, symbol and logo. The default coin model sells round
consumables and looks, never permanent stat power:
store.sku("feather", { coins: 40 });                               // one level of the "feather" upgrade for the round
store.sku("skin_sunset", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } }); // an outfit, owned for good
Keep the five SKUs the client is wired to (feather, sprint, shield,
skin_sunset, skin_frost) at their prices, with the outfits' grants (sunset 1,
frost 2). "Cosmetics only": economy({ store: "cosmetics" }). PvP pots are not
part of this template.

### Change who the climbers are (the asset library)
players: { prefab: "style.lowpoly.astronaut", ... } (the template's own is style.lowpoly.rogue) (any character; it plays
run, idle and jump). Coins draw style.lowpoly.coin, seat bots
style.lowpoly.mini_female_c, and the cliffs carry trees, rocks and bushes.

## Test

engine.test.run({ ticks: 60 * 240, bots: 4, assert: [...] }) runs the race
on the server sim with 4 playtest climbers plus seat bots and reports rounds
(wave), runs.won (rounds every playtest climber finished), scorers (climbers
that finished at least once), deaths (falls), earned by rule, softlock, ms per
tick, and fun.routes (the planner's route per course).

## Worked example: src/game.ts

The whole game as the template ships it. Every change starts from this file.

```ts
/**
 * SKYLEDGE: the platformer template (play style
 * "platformer"). Up to eight climbers race along cliffside courses to the
 * flag: run, jump (hold for height, tap for a hop), dash across gaps, ride
 * moving platforms, bounce off springs and stay off the thorns. Coins hang
 * along every route; each climber collects their own. A round is one
 * course; the next round runs the next course. Seat bots fill empty places
 * so a round always has a race.
 *
 * This file is the whole game as the model writes it: declarations only,
 * against the typed API in @netforge/engine. Everything else (the
 * motor, netcode, renderer, bots, route planner, referee) is the template's
 * machinery.
 *
 * Course coordinates are metres, side view: x runs right from the start to
 * the flag, y runs up. blocks are [x, y, width, height] from the bottom-left
 * corner; ledges are [x, y, width] one-way platforms; hazards are
 * [x, y, width, height]; springs are [x, y, power]; coins and checkpoints
 * are [x, y].
 */
import { earn, game, store, system, upgrade } from "@netforge/engine";

/** Ground from x0 to x1, its top at y (4 m deep). */
const ground = (x0: number, x1: number, y = 0): [number, number, number, number] => [x0, y - 4, x1 - x0, 4];
/** A row of n coins from x, `gap` metres apart, at height y. */
const coins = (x: number, y: number, n: number, gap = 1.2): [number, number][] => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [x + i * gap, y]);

export default game({
  template: "platformer",
  style: "lowpoly",
  tickRate: 60,
  places: { cliffs: { chunks: "places/cliffs", spawn: [0, 0, 0] } },
  players: { prefab: "style.lowpoly.rogue", max: 8, bots: 3 },
  // A course has three minutes; the round closes a few seconds after every person has finished.
  round: { seconds: 180 },
  levels: [
    {
      name: "Mossy Steps",
      start: [0, 0],
      flag: [128, 4.5],
      blocks: [
        ground(-8, 24),
        [14, 0, 3, 1.2],
        [17, 0, 3, 2.4],
        ground(28, 50),
        ground(55, 80),
        [62, 5, 7, 0.8],
        ground(90, 100),
        [100, -4, 4, 5.5],
        [104, -4, 4, 7],
        [108, -4, 30, 8.5],
      ],
      ledges: [[40, 2.6, 4]],
      hazards: [[35, 0, 2, 0.5], [72, 0, 2, 0.5]],
      springs: [[59, 0, 21]],
      movers: [{ at: [81, 0, 3], to: [5, 0], seconds: 4 }],
      coins: [...coins(4, 1, 5), ...coins(14.8, 2.4, 1), ...coins(18, 3.6, 2), ...coins(41, 3.6, 3), ...coins(63, 6.4, 5), ...coins(84, 1.4, 3), ...coins(112, 5.4, 4)],
      checkpoints: [[31, 0], [92, 0]],
    },
    {
      name: "Windmill Gap",
      start: [0, 0],
      flag: [150, 6],
      blocks: [
        ground(-8, 18),
        [12, 0, 6, 2],
        ground(24, 34, 2),
        [38, -2, 6, 4],
        ground(52, 70, 1),
        [58, 1, 2, 2.2],
        ground(84, 96, 3),
        [96, -1, 8, 4],
        ground(118, 160, 6),
        [126, 6, 3, 2],
      ],
      ledges: [[46, 3.6, 3], [74, 3.4, 3], [104, 4.8, 3], [110, 6.2, 3]],
      hazards: [[64, 1, 3, 0.5], [88, 3, 2, 0.5], [136, 6, 2, 0.5]],
      springs: [],
      movers: [
        { at: [74, 1, 3], to: [0, 4], seconds: 3.5 },
        { at: [112, 2, 3], to: [0, 3], seconds: 3, phase: 0.5 },
      ],
      coins: [...coins(13, 3, 4), ...coins(26, 3.2, 5), ...coins(47, 4.8, 2), ...coins(58.3, 4, 1), ...coins(85, 4.4, 3), ...coins(105, 6, 2), ...coins(130, 7.4, 6)],
      checkpoints: [[54, 1], [120, 6]],
    },
    {
      name: "Summit Run",
      start: [0, 0],
      flag: [168, 14],
      blocks: [
        ground(-8, 20),
        [20, -4, 6, 5],
        [30, -4, 6, 7],
        ground(42, 60, 3),
        [48, 3, 3, 1],
        ground(66, 82, 5),
        [74, 5, 2, 3],
        [88, 4, 6, 1],
        ground(98, 120, 8),
        [124, 9, 6, 1],
        [134, 10, 6, 1],
        ground(146, 176, 14),
      ],
      ledges: [[60, 6.5, 4], [113, 11, 4]],
      hazards: [[54, 3, 3, 0.5], [102, 8, 2, 0.5], [110, 8, 2, 0.5], [156, 14, 2, 0.5]],
      springs: [[16, 0, 22], [80, 5, 22], [118, 8, 21]],
      movers: [{ at: [138, 11, 3], to: [5, 2], seconds: 3.2 }],
      coins: [...coins(8, 1.2, 4), ...coins(16, 6, 3), ...coins(43, 4.4, 4), ...coins(61, 8, 3), ...coins(89, 6.2, 4), ...coins(125, 11, 3), ...coins(150, 15.4, 5)],
      checkpoints: [[44, 3], [100, 8], [148, 14]],
    },
  ],
});

// Run upgrades, sold in the store for the rest of the round (one level each).
// Platformer upgrades raise speed (run speed), amount (extra air jumps), magnet (coin reach),
// maxHealth (shield hits per life) or haste (dash cooldown).
upgrade("feather", { stat: "amount", step: 1, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("sprint", { stat: "speed", step: 0.1, maxLevel: 1 });
upgrade("shield", { stat: "maxHealth", step: 1, maxLevel: 1 });

// A clean climb: reach the flag without a fall.
system("clean_climb", ({ on, emit }) => {
  const falls = new Map<number, number>();
  on("player.fell", (ids) => {
    for (const id of ids) falls.set(id, (falls.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
  });
  on("player.finished", (ids) => {
    const clean = ids.filter((id) => (falls.get(id) ?? 0) === 0);
    if (clean.length > 0) emit("climb.clean", clean);
  });
  // A player's earning run started over (signed in, or staked): their count does too.
  on("run.started", (ids) => {
    for (const id of ids) falls.delete(id);
  });
});

// Earn (mandatory). Pays the game's coins (1 coin = 1 token), once per round each.
// Seat bots never earn, and winning a field of bots pays nothing extra. Values are PLACEHOLDER.
earn.rule("pocketful", { when: "coin.collected", n: 12, pay: 4, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("summit", { when: "player.finished", n: 1, pay: 10, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("clean_climb", { when: "climb.clean", n: 1, pay: 12, oncePer: "run" });
earn.rule("first_flag", { when: "race.won", n: 1, pay: 25, oncePer: "run" });
// Buy-in run (the mandatory sink loop): stake coins at run start to earn above free play.
// A staked run also pays up to stake x multiple, by the share of this run's earn the player makes. PLACEHOLDER.
earn.stake({ min: 10, max: 100, multiple: 2 });

// Store (the Kit), priced in coins: three round upgrades and two cosmetic outfits owned for good.
store.sku("feather", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("sprint", { coins: 40 });
store.sku("shield", { coins: 60 });
store.sku("skin_sunset", { coins: 300, grants: { cosmetic: 1 } });
store.sku("skin_frost", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } });
// Losable gear: one shield into every staked run, lost when that run makes less than loseBelow of its most earn. PLACEHOLDER.
store.sku("shield_charm", { coins: 120, grants: { gear: "shield", loseBelow: 0.25 } });
```

## Validate and playtest

- Validate: the MCP tool `netforge_validate_game` builds `src/game.ts` and returns one actionable line per problem (an unknown asset id, a missing earn.stake, a bad id). The same checks throw `GameDefinitionError` when the module is imported.
- Playtest: the MCP tool `netforge_run_playtest`, or in code `engine.test.run({ ticks: 60 * 240, bots: 4, assert: [] })`. It reports rounds (wave), runs.won (rounds every playtest climber finished), scorers, deaths (falls), earned by rule, softlock, ms per tick and fun.routes (the planner's route per course).
- Template tests: test/harness.test.ts, test/host.test.ts, test/race.test.ts, test/store.test.ts, run with `npx vitest run` in this package.
- Play locally: put `src/game.ts` and a `netnet.json` of `{"template":"platformer"}` in a folder, install `@netforge/kit-play` and `@netforge/engine`, and run `npx kit-play` (or the MCP tool `netforge_play_locally`). It opens http://127.0.0.1:4663 with play money.
- Docs: https://forge.netnet.capital/docs/templates/platformer
